Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/markdown", uri="https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md")
    config = ExtractionConfig(chunking={"chunker_type": "markdown", "max_chars": 500, "max_overlap": 50, "trim": True})
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].chunks)

asyncio.run(main())
```
